chapter.verse: Ute naute aw, mi khat kikeem khialin mawhna khatpeuh ahih khak leh, Kha Siangtho a nei note in mawhna hong zolna tawh na kipelh nadingun kikeemin, lungnemna tawh tua bang mi na kipsak un.
Van puak ding a omte khat leh khat kihuhin na pua un la, Khazih’ thukham na zui un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, mi khat in bangmah ahi lo napi-in na khat peuhpeuh ka hi ci-in a ki-up leh, tua mi in ama pumpi a kheem hi.
Ahih hangin mi khempeuh in ama bawlna thu kidong ciat uh hen. Tua bang ahih leh, midangte tawh kiteh loin ama tung bekah lung kiphat theihna a om ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, mi khempeuh in ama van ciat a pua ding uh hi.
Pasian’ Thu a sin mi in a hilhpa tungah a hoihna a om khempeuh hawmsawn ta hen.
Note in na ngaihsun khial kei un. Pasian in thudon lohnate mang ahi kei hi. Mi khatpeuh in khaici a vawh bangin a gah a at kik ding hi.
Ama pumpi ading khaici a vawh mi in ama ci-le-sa hangah muatna a at ding hi. Kha Siangtho hangah khaici a vawh mi in Kha Saingtho hangah nuntak tawntungna a at ding hi.
Eite in lungkia loin gamtat hoih gamta ni. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, lungkia loin i om leh, a hun a tun’ ciangin a gah i at ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin eite in a kilawm a kituak hun i neih bangin mi khempeuh tungah thupha bawlin, adiak diakin thu-um innkuanpihte tungah nakpi-in bawl ni.
Bang zah a lian laimalte tawh ka khutin ka gelh, na en un.
Amaute pumpi uh tawh kipawl minthan’na a deih mite in, Khazih’ singlamteh hangah thuakna leh bawlsiatna tawh kipelh nuam bekin, note vunat thuak nadingin zawhthawh thu tawh hong zol uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, vunatna a thuak mite in Thukham zui loin note’ pumpi uh hangin kisathei nuamin note vunat nading a deih uh hi.

Kei ka hih leh, eite Topa Zeisu Khazih’ singlamteh sim loh, bangmah dangah ka kisathei het kei ding hi. Tua singlamteh ah hih leitung in kei ading kikhenin a om hi. Keimah in zong leitung ading kikhenin ka om hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, vunatna in phattuamna a om kei hi, vunat lohna in zong phattuamna a om kei hi: mi thak suahna bek in phattuamna a om hi.
Hih ngeina a zui mi khempeuh tungah ahi zongin, Pasian’ Israel mi pawlte tungah ahi zongin nopna leh hehpihna om ta hen.
Tu-a kipanin kuamah in kei hong nawngkaisak kei hen. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ka pumpi tungah Zeisu’ ciamtehnate ka pua hi.
Ute naute aw, i Topa Zeisu Khazih’ hehpihna thupha in note lungsim uh tawh omkhawm ta hen. Amen.
